items.title: How Dividend Growth At Linde (LIN) Has Changed Its Investment Story
items.summary: Linde plc recently completed two euro-denominated fixed income offerings totaling about €1.3b and reported third quarter 2026 results that showed higher sales year on year but lower quarterly net income and earnings per share. The business is restructuring its U.S. home care unit, Lincare, while still raising its dividend, which points to management prioritising both portfolio repair and consistent cash returns to shareholders.
